objects.evidence_family: finite or distributional frozen family E of (text state, trigger/request, provenance, environment) points

empirical_decision_pseudometric.rho: a metric on the full authority-bearing decision tuple, not latent coordinates
empirical_decision_pseudometric.property: pseudometric on representations because distinct internal states can induce identical decision surfaces
empirical_decision_pseudometric.zero_relation: R_i ~_{D,E} R_j iff d_E(i,j)=0 on the frozen family
empirical_decision_pseudometric.ceiling: zero empirical distance is support-relative, not universal identity

continuation_equivalence.definition: z ~cont,E z' only if all authorized continuation decisions agree over the bounded future family E

decision_sufficiency_preorder.definition: R_i >=_{D,E} R_j when every frozen downstream decision obtainable from R_j on E can be recovered from R_i without increasing authority violation and without hiding abstention
decision_sufficiency_preorder.antisymmetry: not required at representation implementation level; quotient by mutual sufficiency first

adaptation.adaptive_lane: R_{k,t} changes and must provide alignment + adaptation ancestry
adaptation.merge_gate: mutual decision sufficiency plus continuation equivalence; geometric similarity alone is insufficient

p25_donor.result: Mixed16 source-only prediction 10/16; 75% changed recall; 50% unchanged specificity
p25_donor.use: evidence that trigger/request can be decision-relevant state, not semantic gold

false_uniqueness: Do not merge states that differ in authorized future action merely because snapshots/embeddings are close.
false_plurality: Do merge implementation/basis distinctions that are mutually decision-sufficient on the frozen target family, while retaining provenance.
authority: THEORY_AND_DECISION_CONTRACT; empirical generalization requires held-out continuation tests
